أرتمي (form VIII)
# أَرْتَمِي (ʔartamī) /ʔar.ta.miː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَمَى (irtamā)
# أَرْتَمِيَ (ʔartamiya) /ʔar.ta.mi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَمَى (irtamā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
